say:1:1460153001:1.text: Hi, come on in! I'm Drum, and this is my forge!
say:1:1460153001:1.source_cn: 哈！客人，欢迎光临德拉姆的锻造铺！
say:1:1460153001:1.male: Hi, come on in! I'm Drum, and this is my forge!
say:1:1460153001:1.female: Hi, come on in! I'm Drum, and this is my forge!

say:2:1460153002:1.text: In case you didn't know, you're looking at the best underground blacksmith—me!
say:2:1460153002:1.source_cn: 这地界上，若是想找比我手艺更好的铁匠，那恐怕得去做梦了。
say:2:1460153002:1.male: In case you didn't know, you're looking at the best underground blacksmith—me!
say:2:1460153002:1.female: In case you didn't know, you're looking at the best underground blacksmith—me!

say:3:1460153003:1.text: Let me say this upfront—my creations aren't for nobles who only care about showing off their wealth.
say:3:1460153003:1.source_cn: 我这儿的装备可不是给那些只有花架子的贵族准备的！
say:3:1460153003:1.male: Let me say this upfront—my creations aren't for nobles who only care about showing off their wealth.
say:3:1460153003:1.female: Let me say this upfront—my creations aren't for nobles who only care about showing off their wealth.

say:4:1460153004:1.text: But if you're after something truly practical, you've come to the right place!
say:4:1460153004:1.source_cn: 你要想挑一件真正用得趁手的武器，那你可算是来对了地方!
say:4:1460153004:1.male: But if you're after something truly practical, you've come to the right place!
say:4:1460153004:1.female: But if you're after something truly practical, you've come to the right place!
